about-time.evidence: Actual archived publisher Mini Rules, game-elements page and 2008-UK token clarification recovered. Full printed rulebook remains distinct. Earlier plural-domain successful-PDF-only empty result and current minimal redirect are not proof of absence. Historical singular publisher and old playabouttime.com HTML were inspected without executing Flash.

alpha-nature.evidence: Retailer request still returns a browser challenge, not rules. All nine first-page BGG images were retrieved and viewed in a contact sheet: covers/box base, board, natural pieces/bag and example cards, no complete instruction leaflet. The short BGG description and related Alpha Animals manual are not substituted. The original box-base photograph is a further possible limited reference, not yet accepted as full rule coverage.

ddr-reise.evidence: Direct Wikipedia returned 403. The community gameplay description remains a limited discovery lead. Original BGG Rules Cover image is only a cover, and the box-back photograph is an overview; both were retrieved/viewed. No full manual or complete setup/arrival movement rules accepted.

camp-granada.evidence: Public collector article supplies setup/core overview, and Gambiter has an attributed encyclopedic gameplay account and card examples, but no original complete rule leaflet was retrieved. Specific award-card handling and complete initial distribution remain unchecked. Don’s Game Closet points to its rules sales page rather than a free rulebook. Its listing and collector photos do not establish full original instruction coverage. Five BGG gallery captions likewise show board/box/animals, not a manual. No purchase or contact attempted.

hydro-battle.evidence: Original Pressman first instruction-page photograph retrieved/viewed: top/basic components and start of setup only, lower text outside photograph; no complete play/shot-entry/end procedures. Actual archived 1998 Pressman product page confirms Hydro Battle, catalogue 7900, five ships, laser torpedo launcher and spray. HydroZap has detailed original instructions but is a different reaction/memory game; Hydrostrike is a different water game. Neither substituted. The Hydro/title/7900 CDX results and first 250 instruction-directory records were inspected; full Hydro Battle manual not found in these bounded checks. Further captures/numbered files remain unexhausted.

gespensterburg.evidence: Image captions call these front/back of manual, but direct visual inspection shows Remus 1990 packaging covers, cassette and a board overview. No complete instructions or cassette script/audio is recovered. Local summary says Noris and does not describe mandatory cassette event instructions; publisher/mechanism discrepancies are not silently repaired from cover text alone.

deal-me-in.evidence: Original inside-lid photo was retrieved and viewed. It has complete pictured poker scoring and condensed quick rules, and explicitly says FULL RULES ENCLOSED. Missing initial hand/deal/refill and other full-rules details prevent accepting it as complete base coverage. It is a concrete primary-reference lead, not automatically rejected as an empty box.

battle-sphere.evidence: Both images captioned Rules were retrieved/viewed. They show the same folded rulebook front with introductory setting, plus packaging/insert art. Interior game rules are not visible, so no manual accepted.

advanced-third-reich.evidence: Remaining BGG image pages add optional/variant tables and help sheets, many pointing to the known Camustafa rules rewrite file. They do not themselves reproduce the complete core rulebook. All 137 advertised image captions were examined across three pages; this is not a full visual audit of all 137 images.

circus-imperium.evidence: Second gallery page adds a curled rulebook cover, not complete rule pages. All 81 advertised captions were examined across two pages; not a full visual audit of every image.

connected_drive.evidence: Two valid metadata-only filename-filter searches found no eligible results for A3R/Third Reich and Hydro/DDR-Reise/Alpha Nature. Two earlier malformed filter expressions returned 400 and were corrected; errors are not counted as empty successful searches. No file content fetched, no private IDs or unrelated metadata retained in public ledgers. Scope is these literal names/aliases, not all remaining games or all Drive contents.
